description: This file defines a Java interface for reading client family members data within the Fineract project. It declares methods for retrieving a list of family members for a specified client, fetching a specific family member by ID, and retrieving a template data object.

classes.name: ClientFamilyMembersReadPlatformService
classes.description: A Java interface providing methods to access client family members data, including retrieving all family members for a client, a specific family member, and a template data object.

methods.name: getClientFamilyMembers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of family members associated with a specific client based on the clientId.

methods.name: getClientFamilyMember
methods.description: Fetches a specific family member's data based on the provided family member ID.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template ClientFamilyMembersData object, possibly for use in creating or editing family member data.
